title: Giving away 100 SEK to whoever tops the leaderboard in my free trading game this month
author: aktier_investor
selftext:
I built a free paper-trading app (InvestAI) where everyone starts with 100,000 fake kronor and trades at real stock prices no real money at risk, just a way to practice and compete.

To make it more fun, I'm putting up 100 SEK of my own money for whoever's #1 on the public leaderboard exactly one month from today (\[datum\]). No purchase necessary, no fees, no catch  just play the free game. I'll Swish the winner myself once the month is up, and the leaderboard is public the whole time so anyone can watch it update.

Rules, such as they are: one entry per person, winner is whoever's ranked #1 when the month ends, and if there's a tie I'll split it. That's it.

Not posting a link here since I know that gets threads removed  DM me if you want to join in.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: a one month leaderboard with a cash prize mostly rewards whoever puts the whole 100k into one wild stock and gets lucky. capping position size, or ranking on return per unit of drawdown, would make the winner someone who actually traded well.
